scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Your base level is too low, come back when you hit level 60+.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
您的基础等级太低了，请达到60级后再来。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
^ff0000If you attempt to tame any monsters, it will not count as a kill. Please be careful.^000000
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
^ff0000如果您尝试驯服魔物，将不会被计为击杀。请小心。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Oh, a curious onlooker? I'm Marry Jae, the person in charge of weekends among the days of the week.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
哦，一位好奇的旁观者？我是玛丽·杰，负责一周中周末事务的人。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
What is the weekend dungeon? Actually, it's a specially designed space for new adventurers to train.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
什么是周末地下城？其实，它是专为新冒险者训练而设计的空间。

scripts.text: ^0000FFLooking around, it's obvious that Marry Jae is talking to you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF环顾四周，很明显玛丽·杰正在和你说话。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
For those who do not have a party on the weekends, this place is hunting and experience gaining grounds for lonely adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
对于周末没有队伍的人来说，这里是孤独冒险者的狩猎和获取经验的地方！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Besides, the experience gain here is very generous.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
而且，这里的经验值获取非常丰厚。

scripts.text: When is the opening time?
scripts.translation: 开放时间是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The dungeon will be open during:
^0000FFSaturday 00:00 ~ Sunday 23:59^000000
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
地下城将在以下时间开放：
^0000FF周六 00:00 ~ 周日 23:59^000000

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
I hope to see you when the weekend arrives~
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
期待周末与您相见~

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You need to form a party of one member or more.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
您需要组建一个至少包含一名成员的队伍。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Sorry, but the entry period to the {0} has expired.
Take a rest while waiting for the dungeon to be available again.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
抱歉，进入{0}的期限已过。
请休息片刻，等待地下城再次开放。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The cooldown has expired.
You may re-enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
紧急冷却已结束。
您可以重新进入记忆地下城。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
I think you're just about ready.
Now, would you like to enter it now?
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
我想您已经准备好了。
那么，您现在要进入吗？

scripts.text: Enter Weekend Dungeon
scripts.translation: 进入周末地下城

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
The Memorial Dungeon has been created.
You may now enter.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
记忆地下城已创建。
您现在可以进入了。

scripts.text: There is no Memorial Dungeon registered.
scripts.translation: 没有注册的记忆地下城。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Off you go!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
去吧！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
You have not prepared?
Can't really help it I guess.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
您还没有准备好吗？
那我也没办法了。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
I offer packaging services for those who wish to present a precious gift to a cherished one.
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
我为那些想向珍视之人赠送珍贵礼物的人提供包装服务。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
If you have 5 units of <ITEM>{0}<INFO>23143</INFO></ITEM> or <ITEM>{1}<INFO>23142</INFO></ITEM>, I can pack it for just ^FF0000{2}^000000 Zeny!
Do you want to pack it right now?
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
如果您有5个<ITEM>{0}<INFO>23143</INFO></ITEM>或<ITEM>{1}<INFO>23142</INFO></ITEM>，我只需^FF0000{2}^000000 Zeny就能为您包装！
您现在要包装吗？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Growth Elixir Packing
scripts.translation: 成长灵药包装

scripts.text: Job Elixir Packing
scripts.translation: 职业灵药包装

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Come back whenever you need packaging services!
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
需要包装服务时，随时欢迎回来！

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Please come back when you have enough materials.
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
请准备好足够的材料后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Please come back when you have enough Zeny.
{0}z to be specific.
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
请准备好足够的Zeny后再回来。
具体需要{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
You have too many kinds of objects. Clear your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
您的物品种类太多了。请清理一下背包。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Can't continue because you have too many heavy objects. Reduce your total weight by clearing your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
由于您携带的重型物品过多，无法继续。请清理背包以减轻总重量。

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Confirm to spend {0}z to package 5 <ITEM>{1}<INFO>{2}</INFO></ITEM> into <ITEM>{3}<INFO>{4}</INFO></ITEM>?
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
确认花费{0} Zeny，将5个<ITEM>{1}<INFO>{2}</INFO></ITEM>包装成<ITEM>{3}<INFO>{4}</INFO></ITEM>吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gift Supplies Clerk]
Come back whenever you need packaging services!
scripts.translation:
[礼品供应职员]
需要包装服务时，随时欢迎回来！

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Before we start setting up the environment here, we'll give you the chance to choose an appropriate difficulty level.
I could make my own choice, but each person handles it differently based on their abilities.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
在开始布置这里的环境之前，我会给您选择合适难度的机会。
虽然我可以替您做决定，但每个人根据自己的能力会有不同的处理方式。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Your base level is too low to select this, you need to be level {0} + .
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
您的基础等级太低，无法选择此项，需要达到{0}级或以上。

scripts.text:
[Marry Jae]
Good luck finding the treasures!
scripts.translation:
[玛丽·杰]
祝您寻宝顺利！
